title: Gemini mission management and "Operations Organization for Mission Period" org charts
description: Page titled "MISSION MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITY" with two organization charts. The first links NASA Headquarters Office of Manned Space Flight program management to Manned Spacecraft Center project management, with tracking and data acquisition (MSC, GSFC, ETR), spacecraft (McDonnell Aircraft Co.) and launch vehicle contractors. The second, "OPERATIONS ORGANIZATION FOR MISSION PERIOD," shows the Mission Director over launch operations, flight operations, medical, public affairs, flight crew and DOD recovery functions; a table lists program officials by title.
